sentences: Traders moved $731 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-06-29, across 16.4 million individual trades. with 35,423 wallets placing their first-ever bet (above the recent trend). Algorithmic wallets accounted for 92% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 8%.
The most-traded market was "Will France win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?", pulling in $5 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.

An unusual reversal: retail traders outperformed bots this week. Active retail earned $2 million (+247 bps on volume) while algorithms lost $3 million (-27 bps). Weeks like this are rare (bots are typically on top by the execution channel).
